# Internet fan-sprite sources

## Anime Coder — Naruto

Repository: https://github.com/vikas0304/vscode-anime

License: MIT. Copyright (c) 2026 Vikas Pal.

The repository README states that the sprite art for the initial release was generated with AI. This project uses the Naruto idle/walk PNGs as an optional online-loaded fan-made 2D animation set. The game caches successful downloads under `user://external_sprites/` and falls back to the bundled local Naruto art when offline.

Files used:
- `idle_1.png`
- `idle_2.png`
- `walk_1.png`
- `walk_2.png`
- `walk_3.png`
- `walk_4.png`

## Other research

JUS/NZC/MUGEN Naruto fan packs were researched for visual direction. Packs without a clear redistribution license were not copied into this repository. The older MUGEN pack already bundled under `assets/mugen/naruto/` keeps its own provenance in `assets/mugen/CREDITS.md`.
